callbackError.title: Sign-in failed
callbackError.hint: The identity provider refused the sign-in. If the problem persists, contact the administrator of this platform with the message above.

emailNotVerified.title: Verify your email
emailNotVerified.message: An account is waiting for your email address, but your identity provider has not verified it yet.
emailNotVerified.hint: Open the verification email your identity provider sent you, and check your spam folder. Click the link it contains, then click try again.

emailRequired.title: Email address missing
emailRequired.message: Your identity provider did not share your email address with this platform.
emailRequired.hint: The platform needs it to find your invitations. Contact the administrator of this platform.

emailLinkingDisabled.title: Account already exists
emailLinkingDisabled.message: An account already exists for your email address, and this platform does not link sign-ins to existing accounts.
emailLinkingDisabled.hint: Contact the administrator of this platform.

noAccess.title: No access yet
noAccess.description: Your account is active, but you have no workspace and no pending invitation. Ask your administrator to invite you.
